name: RunAnywhere

modes.label: Wally hosted token-billed inference preview (not an arbitrary-code VM)
modes.note: Incomplete or non-resource economics: rates remain null, never interpreted as free.
modes.billing_unit: USD per million input/output tokens, model-specific; live prices require signed-in Console

plans.name: Wally prepaid pay-as-you-go preview
plans.note: Preview service. Prepaid Stripe credits; requests are billed per million tokens at model-specific prices shown only in the signed-in Console. Requests fail at zero balance. Purchased unused credit does not expire while the account remains open and is generally non-refundable.

caveats: Public open-model inference serverless/BYOC/on-prem and local SDK. Not a verified arbitrary code sandbox or raw VM offering; hosted inference pricing unverified. Client OS support does not mean hosted Windows/macOS VMs.
Inventory exclusion: model inference/local SDK, not arbitrary developer compute. Card contains no numeric compute modes and no selectable price plan.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

eu_data_residency.note: No region selection or EU-residency option is documented; processors listed (Google Cloud, Vercel, Stripe, PropelAuth, Resend) are named without any region/residency choice for customers.

usage_api.quote: The endpoint is OpenAI-compatible, so any OpenAI client works against it. Create a Cloud key in the console. ... Errors use the following safe shape; prompts, completions, and upstream bodies are not echoed
usage_api.note: granularity: account-only; cost: no; RunAnywhere (Wally) is an inference API, not a sandbox provider. Billing is per-account per-key against prepaid credits, billed per million tokens. No REST API endpoint exists for retrieving billable usage; the CLI has 'wally account usage' for display and console.runanywhere.ai for dashboard viewing only. Usage is not available per-sandbox or per-resource-tag since RunAnywhere does not provision customer sandboxes/VMs—it provides only hosted model inference API access.
